call.x: Innovation Validation Call 2027 Opportunity 14/10/2026 11.00 - CET 13/01/2027 16.00 - CET EIT EIT Health’s Innovation Validation Call 2027 supports innovative digital and AI-powered medical technologies that are ready for real-world clinical validation and are approaching market launch. This call addresses the funding gap for solutions that need to run clinical studies and collect evidence to demonstrate safety and efficacy, apply for regulatory approval and prepare for commercialisation. Who can apply? Consortia must comprise at least two organisations from different countries, representing at least two sides of the Knowledge Triangle (industry, research, education). HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
